notes_for_editor: The 1934 build year rests on one 2008 state list, which also marks the tower scheduled for disposal, while FFLA still shows it standing. Confirm current status and any disposal with Minnesota DNR Forestry before publishing a fate. Norris Camp (NRHP 94001080) is a separate CCC-era district; no source links it to the tower. The 2008 list has a Forestry footnote about historic buildings at Norris Camp, which does not mention the tower; the story reports it. No access or staffing record found. No photos found.
